solution:
**Given:**

The high and low rates of Ambuja cement in different stock exchanges:

 
• Mumbai: High = 150, Low = 155
 
• Uttarakhand: High = 120, Low = 125
 
• Rajasthan: High = 160, Low = 135
 
• Uttar Pradesh: High = 145, Low = 170

**Formula used:**

Ratio = High rate / Low rate

**Calculation:**

 
• Mumbai: Ratio = 150 / 155 = 0.9677
 
• Uttarakhand: Ratio = 120 / 125 = 0.96
 
• Rajasthan: Ratio = 160 / 135 = 1.1852
 
• Uttar Pradesh: Ratio = 145 / 170 = 0.8529

The highest ratio is in Rajasthan, where the ratio is 1.1852.

**∴ The ratio of the high rate of share to the low rate is maximum in the Rajasthan stock exchange.**
